name: Remix: Hole in one
description: A top-down mini-golf game featuring multi-language localization (Spanish, English, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese), 100+ collectible balls and particle trails, 7-Tier Competitive Ranking System (Rookie Tee to Hole in One), Real-Time Online 1v1 Multiplayer, Daily Shop rotation, Mystery Chests, Martin Luquetta creator suite, and cloud progression.
